Oneliner

Capable of calculating its own altitude and position in space with unprecedented precision.
Description

Capable of calculating its own altitude and position in space with unprecedented precision thus paving the way for nano-satellite constellations with inter-satellite communication capabilities. - precise orbit determination. GNSS comparison and combination. Experimental measurements (radio occultations, reflectometry, air density estimation (during re-entry phase only)).
